upstream.distinction: Full grammar CST recognition, typed AST acceptance, static validity and runtime equivalence are different assurance levels.

extension_gate: Preserve all admitted constructor/modifier fields in protocol/parser-ast.json; reject unimplemented fields.
Define types, bags/NULL, errors/effects; extend Rust interpretation and Alloy encoding together.
Account for every intermediate occurrence/value/error; excessive scope yields refusal, never safety.
Add actual PG positive/negative/composition/boundary cases and unchanged authentic examples where catalog/session context is known.
Cross-check symbolic SAT/UNSAT using independent exhaustive finite inputs; replay witnesses and kill targeted mutants.
Pass trust/protocol/style/regression gates and close independent review findings.
Update this ledger/canonical evidence and remove temporary experiments/duplicate reports.
mvp_release_gates: Account for every pinned typed-AST family; unsupported families cannot silently leave MVP scope.
Publish per-case export/bind/execute/analyze census for pinned synthetic/authentic corpora, with denominators and unexplained rejections resolved or user-approved.
Parsing coverage is not transaction safety; verify effects, constraints, errors and rollback.
Native Windows/Linux/macOS CI, clean-machine packaging and dependency provenance/notices.
Parser redistribution permission, hosted job isolation, BYOT and instance-rendering security.
assurance_limits: Native M1 independently encodes the admitted pure read algebra. Extended writes/errors/effects use evaluator-backed finite tables with PostgreSQL differential evidence; they do not model unrestricted RLS/triggers or concurrent schedules.
Explicit finite domains/capacities; unknown/resource failure never produces a security verdict.
Lean contracts and parser trust auditing do not prove Rust SQL-to-Alloy preservation.
Deterministic compilation; solver-selected witnesses may vary by platform/version.
Windows x64 executed; Linux/macOS/WSL and deployment unvalidated.

corpus_target.definition: Correct semantics under explicit contexts, including expected PostgreSQL errors; unsupported/resource/engine refusals do not count.
corpus_target.claim: All declared authentic-schema baseline/nonempty fixtures match actual PostgreSQL16 outcomes and evaluator-backed Alloy tables. Broader typed-AST, arbitrary data and concurrency remain separate MVP obligations.
